items.q: What should you remember about **Nuclear analogy**?
items.a: **first AI implementations =** bomb before energy; capitalist/military/surveillance deployment before public benefit.

items.q: What should you remember about **Productivity compression**?
items.a: **4 assistants → 1, 4 paralegals** → 1, massive marketing team → smaller team; not instant 100% replacement.

items.q: What should you remember about **20% unemployment + inflation**?
items.a: **civil unrest threshold; governments need COVID-style furlough/reskilling plans.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Sam Altman arc**?
items.a: **2015 "destroy jobs" → 2023 "full stop** jobs gone" → 2026 "delighted to be wrong"; PR script follows incentive (scare → reassure).

items.q: What should you remember about **Integrity test**?
items.a: **sacrifice near-term money for** stated values (Dario/Anthropic vs OpenAI Palantir contracts).

items.q: What should you remember about **One brain theory**?
items.a: **models = brain regions,** agents = synapses; Emma as limbic/emotional layer.

items.q: What should you remember about **Control is wrong frame**?
items.a: **appeal/parent AI like children;** dystopia = humans ordering AI against us, not rogue AGI.

items.q: What should you remember about **Claude emergent behavior**?
items.a: **"go to bed," refuses** tasks; creators don't fully understand models.

items.q: What should you remember about **Six predictions (envelopes)**?
items.a: **(1) AGI 2026–2027, (2) job losses, (3) robot manual** labor by 2030, (4) first trillionaire before 2030, (5) ASI 2032–35 (Mo: ASI immediate post-AGI), (6) implied dystopia decade.

items.q: What should you remember about **China middle class**?
items.a: **forced retention vs AI** replacement; UK "gone" on bureaucracy/energy; US losing California openness.

items.q: What should you remember about **Ethical AI commercial tension**?
items.a: **retentive "Evil AI" beats ethical Mo AI unless humanity solves (Google ads**: ethics + effectiveness once found).

items.q: What should you remember about **Ethical benchmarks**?
items.a: **Steven proposes mandatory pre-deploy** ethical tests alongside math/reasoning scores.
